refresh-note.description: Changes apply right away. The panel also refreshes when you open it, after you unlock the screen, and when the computer wakes from sleep.

limits-interval.tooltip: Keeps the percentage in the panel current; opening the panel always checks right away. Anthropic refuses checks that come too often, and checking then pauses for 1 to 15 minutes.

scan-interval.tooltip: Rereads transcripts and OpenCode history for the token charts.

session-threshold.tooltip: Once the 5-hour session limit is this full, the panel shows it, even when the weekly limit is fuller. Below it, the panel shows the fullest limit. 0 always shows the session limit.

session-colors.tooltip: The robot turns orange while a Claude Code or OpenCode session waits for you, and green once one has finished, until you open the panel. Works through hooks in Claude Code and a plugin in OpenCode 2; switching this off removes them.

launch-note.description: What the panel's open button, and right-clicking the robot, opens: an agent in a terminal, or a desktop app.

terminal.tooltip: Automatic uses the terminal from Preferred Applications. Signing in and updating use it too, also with a desktop app.

terminal-command.tooltip: {command} is replaced by the agent's command, e.g. ghostty -e {command}. Without it, the agent goes at the end.

try-launch.tooltip: Opens the agent exactly as the panel's open button does.

check-updates.tooltip: Every hour and after waking from sleep. Asks the git repository this was installed from. The panel says when one is out.

update-now.tooltip: Runs agent-usage update in your terminal. The applet reloads itself when it's done.
